# --profile must actually select a profile's config, not just parse.
#
# Regression test: the flag was registered and read, but its value never reached
# the config loader, so every command silently used the base profile.

# MUSHER_API_URL is set by the harness and would outrank both config files.
env MUSHER_API_URL=

mkdir $MUSHER_CONFIG_HOME/profiles/staging
cp $WORK/base-config.yaml $MUSHER_CONFIG_HOME/config.yaml
cp $WORK/staging-config.yaml $MUSHER_CONFIG_HOME/profiles/staging/config.yaml

# without the flag, the base config wins
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input config get api.url
stdout '^https://base\.example\.com$'

# with the flag, the profile's value wins
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --profile staging config get api.url
stdout '^https://staging\.example\.com$'
! stdout 'base\.example\.com'

# MUSHER_PROFILE selects the same profile
env MUSHER_PROFILE=staging
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input config get api.url
stdout '^https://staging\.example\.com$'

# the flag outranks the env var
env MUSHER_PROFILE=staging
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --profile default config get api.url
stdout '^https://base\.example\.com$'

env MUSHER_PROFILE=

# the profile is reported as active and listed
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --profile staging config profile active
stdout '^staging$'

# 'profile list' marks the active profile on stderr and the rest on stdout
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input config profile list
stderr 'default \(active\)'
stdout 'staging'

# keys absent from the profile still fall through to the base config
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --profile staging config get network.ca_cert_file
stdout '^/tmp/base-ca\.pem$'

-- base-config.yaml --
api:
  url: https://base.example.com
network:
  ca_cert_file: /tmp/base-ca.pem
-- staging-config.yaml --
api:
  url: https://staging.example.com
